data.name: Safety_AutoDisabled_Format
data.value: Hooking was turned off for this game after repeated crashes shortly after injection ({0}). You can turn it back on; the consent dialog will be shown again.

data.name: Safety_Blocked_Toggle_Format
data.value: Hooking is disabled for this game: {0}

data.name: Safety_Consent_AgentUnavailable
data.value: The capture agent is not connected. Nothing was enabled.

data.name: Safety_Consent_AntiCheat
data.value: Anti-cheat systems may flag or ban accounts. FrameLedger refuses to inject where it detects an anti-cheat, and it cannot guarantee it knows every anti-cheat. If one appears after injection, capture stops within 30 seconds of it being detected.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Enable
data.value: Enable hooking

data.name: Safety_Consent_Hooked
data.value: If you enable hooking (Tier 1): the session records every frame's time, the native and displayed frame rates, the render and output resolutions, the upscaler and its quality mode, frame generation, ray tracing, and the hardware telemetry this machine provides.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Injected
data.value: What is injected, and why: FrameLedger.Overlay.dll is loaded into the game process to measure, from inside it, the real render resolution, the upscaler and its quality mode, whether frame generation is active and by how much, and whether ray tracing is in use. Measuring from outside the process cannot establish these accurately.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Intro
data.value: Hooking loads a FrameLedger library into this game's process. This dialog states what that means for this game. It recommends neither choice.

data.name: Safety_Consent_KeepOff
data.value: Keep hooking off

data.name: Safety_Consent_NotHooked
data.value: If you do not enable hooking (Tier 2): the session records its start, end and duration, and the hardware telemetry this machine provides. Every frame-derived value on that session reads N/A. This needs no injection and no elevation, and it is what every game gets until it is individually enabled here.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Phrase
data.value: I ACCEPT THE INJECTION RISK

data.name: Safety_Consent_Terms
data.value: You are responsible for the terms of service of the games you play.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Title_Format
data.value: Enable hooking for {0}?

data.name: Safety_Consent_TypeToConfirm_Format
data.value: To enable hooking for this game, type exactly: {0}

data.name: Safety_Consent_VersionMismatch
data.value: This app and the capture agent carry different versions of this consent text. Nothing was enabled. Restart both, then try again.

data.name: Safety_RecordWithoutMeasuring
data.value: Record this session without measuring it

data.name: Safety_Refused_CouldNotVerify
data.value: FrameLedger could not verify this game's files for anti-cheat, so hooking stays off. It will check again when the game's files or the detection rules change.

data.name: Safety_Refused_Named_Format
data.value: {0} was detected in this game ({1}). FrameLedger will not inject into it, and nothing overrides that.

data.name: Safety_Refused_Unnamed
data.value: An anti-cheat or anti-tamper module was detected in this game. FrameLedger will not inject into it, and nothing overrides that.

data.name: Safety_HookingTurnedOff
data.value: Hooking has been turned off for this game; its page says what was found.

data.name: Safety_Unhooked_Format
data.value: Capture stopped: {0} was detected while the game was running. FrameLedger unhooked and will not inject into this game again until you enable it again.

data.name: Safety_Refused_TargetUnreadable
data.value: The game is running, but Windows would not let FrameLedger open its process: it is protected by an anti-cheat driver, or it runs as administrator while FrameLedger does not. Nothing was injected and this run was not measured. FrameLedger will not work around another product's protection.
